business_problem: Small businesses often lack the teams, research departments, and budgets to evaluate ideas or hire consultants. They need a structured way to identify which customer problems to solve and turn feedback and assumptions into actionable plans.
solution_summary: Idea Morph is described as a web-based platform that makes structured, collaborative ideation available to small businesses; the source does not identify its AI model, hosting, storage, or external integrations. In the described deployment, a business starts with customer reviews and feedback as input, and Idea Morph analyzes them to surface recurring frustrations, including issues with booking and communication. A project in the platform then guides solution generation and refinement, turning scattered opinions and assumptions into clearer ideas and an execution plan. The platform produces a structured document that the business owner can use to build a redesigned website and a mechanism to help customers identify suitable dog food. The story reports that the owner generated and launched the first version in less than two hours. It does not explain where source data is stored, how AI processing is technically implemented, or whether the document is exported or integrated with other systems.

solution_components.name: Idea Morph
solution_components.role: Analyzes customer feedback, guides collaborative idea generation and refinement, and produces a structured plan for the business to act on.

data_flow: The business provides customer reviews and feedback to Idea Morph. The platform analyzes them to identify recurring frustrations; users develop and refine solutions in a project, and Idea Morph produces a structured document that the owner uses to build a website and customer-facing food-selection mechanism.
integration_points: Customer website development (downstream use of the structured document)
business_outcome: Idea Morph helped a small cooked-dog-food business identify customer frustrations and turn the findings into a structured website project. The owner generated and launched the first version in less than two hours.

source_references.title: Bottling the creative process: A woman founder’s AI-powered approach to innovation

evidence_quotes: In 2023, Banuleasa created Idea Morph, a web-based platform that provides a guided, AI-assisted framework for collaborative problem-solving and idea generation.
Instead of guessing, they used Idea Morph to analyze customer reviews and feedback. Very quickly, the platform highlighted recurring frustrations customers had around booking and communication.
In the end, the platform produced a structured document that could be used directly to build the new website, and the owner managed to generate and launch that first version in less than two hours.
